basis: Q2 landed within guidance, but omni-channel comps fell 1.9% and adjusted EBITDA turned negative. The headline EPS of $0.51 is almost all IEEPA tariff refunds ($0.86 of benefit), and ex-refund gross margin fell. 'Appropriately measured in our outlook' against a choppy category reads as a cautious or lowered guide; the numbers are cut off in the text.
